name: draggable-lowering
description: The .draggable applicator lowers to ONE static __dnd.source object (group/handle/activation with defaults filled) plus split bindable pieces: __dnd.sourceEnabled re-resolves per render like any bound prop. No draggable.* junk props ever reach the wire, __dnd.sourcePayload is absent when payload: is not given, and __dnd.key is absent outside a ForEach (renderers fall back to the node id)

input.source: Card("x").draggable(group: "cards", handle: true, activation: press, enabled: @state.canDrag)

steps.description: Initial render carries the static source spec and the resolved enabled flag
Flipping the bound enabled flag re-resolves __dnd.sourceEnabled in place
